name: Annotated Image Dataset for Vision-Based Bolt Detection in Steel Connections for Robotic Deconstruction
description: This dataset contains annotated images of bolted steel connections developed to support research on vision-guided robotic deconstruction of reusable steel structures. The images are annotated with bounding boxes identifying bolt locations and are provided in YOLOv8 object detection format. The dataset includes images and corresponding annotation files, organized into training, validation, and testing subsets. It supports the development, training, and evaluation of machine vision models for automated bolt identification in steel structural connections. The dataset is associated with the research article "Vision-guided robotic approach for reusable steel structures with bolted connections", submitted to Automation in Construction.
